goal: Make candidate cloud-model mode and response boundaries explicit using the existing provider and call ledger.
changes: ProviderSettings gains finite explicit thinking_mode and reasoning_effort fields, serialized only when declared. Historical profile identity stays unchanged.

Thinking tools require complete historical reasoning, reject forced tool selection and ignored temperature, and refuse summary/history deletion before a new reservation or send. No implicit mode switch.
Nullable reasoning/tool_calls are preserved without invented tool messages. Aborted and other incomplete responses retain usage but stop as format errors, including text-only truncation.

Mock SDK fixtures cover two actual tool continuations, a final answer and subsequent user turn, exact reasoning and tool identities on the fourth request, and saved-response replay with no fifth send.

Additional fixtures cover missing reasoning, incompatible summary, removed old turns, explicit disabled mode, old profile roundtrip and incomplete generation. Existing unknown-sent no-retry behavior remains unchanged.
